details: CONFIRMED by reading and the probe. The item's What names three gaps: the sha exists, it is on the default branch, and it
"carries the change". The fix closes the first two; the third is untouched, and the item's live example (rev-parse master
after a fast-forward, landing on a check-record commit) still passes. "Carries the change" in full is meaning (principle 5:
the model), but "the commit changes at least one non-inert file" is a fact code can check with relay_inert.matches over the
commit's diff (first parent for a merge). The owner may instead accept the narrower fix: then it is a follow-up item.

changes only .relay/checks/. Closing a feature with --evidence $(git rev-parse master) records that sha as its evidence.
Now: accepted (it is a commit on the default branch). Should: refused, naming that the commit changes only inert files

inert files (queue, checks, handover): name the merge of the change"). Add pass cases 1-3 as tests.
